name: Hashrate re-arm with DeFi TVL inflow — miner commitment plus on-chain capital rotation
rationale: Rising DeFi total-value-locked is a sign that on-chain capital is being put to work — a risk-appetite signal for the broader crypto complex, especially the smart-contract majors. The thesis combines that capital-rotation signal with BTC miner conviction: when btc_hashrate crosses UP (miners re-arm — Bitcoin-network structural conviction) AND defi_tvl crosses UP (on-chain capital is flowing in across the ecosystem) AND momentum is positive, go long spot — both the base-layer producers and the application-layer capital are leaning in. The asset subset tilts toward the smart-contract/DeFi majors (ETH/SOL/AVAX/LINK/BNB) where TVL is most relevant, while hashrate captures the cross-crypto BTC beta. Both defi_tvl and btc_hashrate are drifting and read ONLY via cross_up/cross_down. Exit when TVL rolls over or miners capitulate. Disconfirmer (core falsifier): the edge must come from the miner (hashrate) arm adding orthogonal info beyond the TVL-inflow signal. If dropping the btc_hashrate cross_up arm (keeping defi_tvl cross_up + ret_Nd>0) matches or beats deflated Sharpe, hashrate is redundant. Low-confidence until OOS; the Gate decides.
catalyst: btc_hashrate crosses up while defi_tvl crosses up (on-chain capital inflow) and momentum is positive
